Students must complete a minimum of 120 units with a Pacific cumulative and program grade point average of 2.0 in order to earn the Bachelor of Music in Jazz Studies (Composition).

Writing

Students are required to take:

1) 8 semesters of at least 16 units of MAPM.

4) A maximum of 16 elective units.
